important_caveat: The broader weakest-line research and this formation family were developed after other 2026 H1 strategy results had already been observed. Therefore 2026 H1 is a fixed-spec backtest, not pristine family-level OOS.

scope.segment_definition: Within each race_date x track, sort exact S-class-yosen races by race_no and assign floor((position-1)*3/total); 中盤 is the middle third.
scope.weakest_line_definition: Unique minimum lead+second competition score among non-main 2+ rider predicted lines; require strongest rival and weakest line to be distinct.

pre_race_condition.name: HIDDEN_ATTACK
logic: W1L nige_count + W1L makuri_count >= R1L nige_count + R1L makuri_count

formation.description: W1L first only; W1B first or second; retain A/B order both ways.
